text_blocks.snippet: Bangladeshi citizens need a visa to travel to India, and this is typically obtained through the Indian embassy or consulate. While e-Visas are available for some nationalities, they are not currently offered for Bangladeshi citizens. Therefore, Bangladeshi citizens need to apply for a traditional, sticker visa at an Indian embassy or consulate.

list.title: Visa Requirement:
list.snippet: Bangladeshi citizens need a valid Indian visa to enter India for tourism, business, or other purposes.

list.title: e-Visa:
list.snippet: Currently, e-Visas are not offered to Bangladeshi citizens.

list.title: Traditional Visa:
list.snippet: Bangladeshi citizens must apply for a traditional, sticker visa at an Indian embassy or consulate.

list.title: Application Process:
list.snippet: The application process involves filling out the visa application form, providing necessary documents (including a passport, photographs, and other supporting documents based on the visa type), and paying the required visa fees.

list.title: Supporting Documents:
list.snippet: Depending on the visa type (tourist, business, etc.), you may need to provide additional documents such as hotel bookings, flight tickets, invitation letters, or proof of financial stability.

list.title: Processing Time:
list.snippet: The processing time for a traditional visa can vary, so it's advisable to apply well in advance of your planned travel date.

list.title: Validity:
list.snippet: Indian visas for Bangladeshi citizens can be valid for various durations, including short-term (e.g., 30 days) or long-term (e.g., multiple entries for up to a year).

list.title: Age Consideration:
list.snippet: For Bangladeshi nationals over 65 years of age, a multiple-entry long-term tourist visa may be granted for a period of five years, subject to specific stay duration conditions.
